_metadata.scope: Reference fees for venues currently in the Markets trading pipeline. Used for any net-bps / EV / cross-strategy comparison. Per `feedback_fees_in_rate_analysis.md`: gross numbers can flip the ranking entirely.

venues_active.fee_source: per `feedback_fees_in_rate_analysis.md` memory; reference rate for the primary perp venue
per memory; reference rate for the primary US spot venue

venues_planned.fee_source: documented in prior handoff; chosen as US-onshore execution venue
venues_planned.deployment_status: not yet collecting; collector and executor are pending workstreams

audit_pipeline_finding.code_observed: FEE_BPS = 5.0  (one-way); net_bps = gross_bps - (2.0 * fee_bps) -> 10 bps round-trip across ALL venues

impact.Bybit_trades: Audit deducts 10 bps but actual is 4 bps -> net_bps understated by 6 bps -> admission gate (15 bps min, 0.30 bps/min min) REJECTS some genuine winners. Admissions are too STRICT for Bybit.
impact.Coinbase_trades: Audit matches actual (10 bps). Admission gate is correctly calibrated.
impact.Kraken_trades: Audit deducts 10 bps but actual is 20 bps -> net_bps overstated by 10 bps -> admission gate ADMITS some trades that won't actually clear net. Admissions are too LENIENT for Kraken.

audit_pipeline_finding.recommended_fix: Replace flat FEE_BPS constant with per-venue lookup table. Re-run audit. Compare admission counts and net_bps distribution per venue before/after.
audit_pipeline_finding.verdict: Admission gate logic is correct (it compares avg_net_bps against thresholds named NET_BPS — the value IS net at that point). The bug is one layer up, in how net_bps was computed from gross_bps in the audit. Verdict per `pnl-review` skill's anti-pattern checklist: closest to 'preflight false negatives' but in this case the fee assumption itself is venue-uniform.

implications_for_strategy_evaluation: Any cross-venue strategy comparison must use venue-specific fees from the start. A strategy that 'wins on Kraken' may be artifact of the audit's understated fees.
The Markets winner list (1690 entries) is filtered against the flat-10bp net assumption. The true admissible set on real per-venue fees is different. How different needs measurement.

Hyperliquid's planned 3-9 bps round-trip is materially cheaper than Coinbase/Kraken and competitive with Bybit. Strategies that are venue-marginal today may become reliably profitable on Hyperliquid once the executor is live.
